item.title: Funke Akindele Breaks Box Office Records in Canada and North America
item.description: Nollywood actress and filmmaker Funke Akindele has once again made Nigeria proud by setting new records in Canadian and North American cinemas with her 2025 movie, Behind The Scenes.The box office queen, who has already crossed ₦2 billion in earnings, announced on Instagram that Behind The Scenes grossed over $111,256 in Canada within its opening days.
